blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong on Tuesday said he wears as a badge of honor his inclusion on a list of lawmakers singled out by the Chinese Embassy in Manila. The Chinese Embassy posted a photo on Facebook on Tuesday listing nine lawmakers who called for Ambassador Jing Quan’s expulsion over his recent remarks, warning in a caption that they were “put on record” and were “now on the list.” Adiong questioned if that list was “those who stand against China’s pattern of intimidation, aggression, and disrespect.” READ: House lawmakers urge Marcos: Reconsider evicting China’s envoy […]...
